response.what_it_is: A pair of aftermarket black-housing headlights for a Honda Accord
hidden_risks: broken or cracked mounting tabs on the rear
compromised weather seals leading to internal moisture or fogging
incompatible wiring connectors or missing bulb sockets
response.best_proof: Close-up photo showing the condition of the rear side mounting tabs and bulb sockets
seller_claims_unsupported: exact year compatibility without inspecting backside part numbers
response.failure_mode: Mistaking custom aftermarket black-housing headlights for damaged or burnt original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts.
